Package com.example.ecolums

Class SustainabilityTip

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.SustainabilityTip
public class SustainabilityTip extends Object
Represents a sustainability tip or educational article published by an admin.

Stored in the Firestore collection sustainabilityTips. Admins create, edit, and delete tips via AdminDashboard. Students read them from the "Sustainability Tips" section of the app.

Outstanding issues: Video embed support is stubbed — needs a video player component integrated in the detail view fragment.
